problem: Which of the following is a solution to the equation 4x^2 + 4x - 15 = 0?

bad.why: Recalling the quadratic formula and simplifying sqrt(256) by hand is memorized-formula work the graph's labeled x-intercepts make unnecessary.
Factoring 4x^2+4x-15 into (2x-3)(2x+5) needs the AC method by hand; a sign slip gives the distractors -3/2 or 5/2.
Evaluating 4x^2+4x-15 at four fractions by hand is slow, error-prone arithmetic.

algebraFirst.description: Factors 4x^2+4x-15 as (2x-3)(2x+5) or applies the quadratic formula to get x=3/2 and x=-5/2, then matches 3/2.

explanationNotes: Solutions of an expression set equal to 0 are the x-intercepts of its graph: graph y=4x^2+4x-15 and click where it crosses the x-axis, (-2.5, 0) and (1.5, 0). Only 1.5 = 3/2 is a choice; make clear that 'solution' here and 'x-intercept' name the same x-value.
